policy: No blanket waiver and no audit fix --force. The raw audit stays red and visible; each remaining finding has a version-bound, path-specific record below that expires and is re-checked on the listed triggers. Approval is the owner's, not Claude's.

records.target: Server-side Meteora adapter (packages/adapter-meteora-dbc) under Node v22.22.2 only; excluded from browser/worker/customer builds by tools/boundary (QF-LIC-EX-001 boundary).
records.callPath: @solana/buffer-layout-utils (u64/u128 layouts) -> bigint-buffer.toBigIntLE/toBufferLE. Upstream dist/node.js tried require("bindings")("bigint_buffer") at module load; the advisory concerns the native toBigIntLE path.
records.inputReachability: Reached by SDK account/instruction layout encode/decode. Inputs are QF-built instruction args (validated u64 by tx validateTerms) and RPC account data (bounded by createBoundedFetch).
records.mitigation: pnpm patchedDependencies bigint-buffer@1.1.5 -> patches/bigint-buffer@1.1.5.patch (sha256 a36b175bf3d9996bf525b88df4d303561321c6ad7dde7e3a3a19374440c781b1) removes the native loader, so every function takes the pure-JS branch. Install scripts remain disabled (--ignore-scripts), no addon is built, and the test asserts no .node file exists in the installed package. The durable control is the patch; ignore-scripts alone is not relied on.
records.residual: Pure-JS toBufferLE silently truncates values wider than the requested width; QF rejects non-u64 amounts before SDK code. bindings@1.5.0 remains installed as a declared dependency but is never required.
evidence: runtime probe in sec-a.test.ts: patched dist/node.js loaded; bindings never loaded
tests: packages/tx/test/binding.test.ts :: approved integers are range-checked to their exact IDL width

records.callPath: @coral-xyz/anchor dist/cjs/workspace.js: toml.parse(fs.readFileSync("Anchor.toml")) inside the lazy `workspace` getter. The module was loaded at runtime before the fix (anchor imports workspace.js eagerly); parse is only called if `anchor.workspace` is accessed.
records.inputReachability: Not reachable from QF: QF never accesses anchor.workspace and ingests no TOML (asserted by source scan). Would only parse a local Anchor.toml in the process working directory.
records.mitigation: pnpm override "@coral-xyz/anchor@0.31.1>toml": "4.2.0" (scoped to anchor only). Test proves anchor resolves 4.2.0, Buffer input parses, deep nesting throws a depth error rather than RangeError, and toml 3.x is never loaded.
records.residual: Override is outside anchor's declared ^3.0.0 range; API parity is tested only for anchor's single call.

records.inputReachability: No external input reaches uuid: v4() takes no arguments on this path.
